workload: Same CLI flags and firmware as idle-final.json, 30 emulated seconds; instrumented binaries are not used for timing.
interpretation: After counts occur only at register/clock configuration boundaries. Empty active lists never call PWM clock, irq_sources or tick during scheduler rounds. The final word-merge change does not alter participation. Main has no PWM model in these dispatch tables.
method: Insert relaxed AtomicU64 increments at the entry of Ledc::clock, irq_sources, tick and write. Print cumulative counts when Ledc is dropped; retain the final cumulative row, including reboots.
privacy: Only aggregate counts retained; raw console and build output remain outside Git.
limitation: Atomic counters can inhibit compiler hoisting; counts describe logical query entries, not hardware instruction counts. Timing measurements use separate uninstrumented binaries.
